name: Hinpyoukai ~Auction~
source:
Main character is a vendor at an auction. His goods are of the high quality respected by everyone. The goods are girls. He uses the position of a teacher and trains the finest quality product. This time he moves out of his comfort zone and marks six new women as preys. He receives requests at an auction.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-february-2001-tasogare.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名拍卖会上的卖家。他出售的商品品质极高，人人都对其赞不绝口。所谓商品，正是女孩。他利用教师的身份，将她们调教成品质最上乘的商品。这一次，他离开了自己熟悉的领域，盯上六名新的猎物，并在拍卖会上接受委托。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-february-2001-tasogare.html]vndbreview[/url]]
